newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's LPMO to seek 8,203T of frozen beef.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's LPMO to seek 8,203T of frozen beef.

text.p: South Korea's Livestock Products Marketing Organization (LPMO) would invite tenders to buy 8,203 tonnes of frozen beef at 2.00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on June 27, an official with the organization said on Friday.
The official said acceptable origins were set for the United States, Canada, Ireland, Sweden, Denmark, Japan, New Zealand, Australia, Finland, Mexico and the Netherlands.
Of the total, shipment for 4,097 tonnes was set for July 25 and the remaining 4,106 tonnes for August 5, he said.
LPMO will re-invite the tenders on July 1, if high prices force the organisation to passes on the tenders scheduled on June 27.
Arrivals were set for Seoul, Pusan, Taegu and Naju.
